SS-BEHAVIOR-PRIMITIVES.Purpose: Single-strategy interpolation behaviors: instant or delayed assignment, duration-based tweening with easing curves, and physical spring integration.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: StaticBehavior: immediate target capture with optional delay.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: TweenBehavior: time-normalized interpolation with retargeting and speed calibration.
Scope.SCP-IN-003: SpringBehavior: tension/mass/damping integration toward a target.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Composition of behaviors into chains or timelines — owned by SS-BEHAVIOR-COMPOSITES.

Principles.PRIN-001: Each primitive owns exactly one interpolation strategy; no primitive delegates to another.

Requirements.REQ-001: Retargeting a running tween preserves elapsed progress semantics instead of restarting from scratch.
Requirements.REQ-002: A spring settles when velocity and remaining distance fall below epsilon, then reports finished.

SS-BEHAVIOR-PRIMITIVES.Codemap: * `StaticBehavior<T>` + `TweenBehavior<T>` + `SpringBehavior<T>` : `Behavior<T>` * `StaticBehavior.Update(deltaTime)` => delay <= 0 => value == target * `TweenBehavior.Update(deltaTime)` -> `Easing(curve, t)` => value * `SpringBehavior.Update(deltaTime)` -> integrate(velocity) => value == target + velocity == 0
